en: Soldier - They say another of our merchant ships carrying ore from Astania has been plundered by pirates.
Baja - What! That's the seventeenth time this year. Things haven't improved one bit since the Pandragon navy was disbanded.
Kaja - Father, at this rate even our Amigo Trading Company will have to close its doors. Shouldn't we find some new way?
Baja - That doesn't mean there's any clever answer. For now, the only thing we can do is cut shipping as much as possible and send goods overland.
Kaja - What if we asked Uncle Arcion to wipe out the pirates of Blueseed Island? Uncle Arcion, captain of the Kashmir, known the world over, could surely crush them.

Baja - It's not that simple. Even if Arcion went into Blueseed and cleared out the pirates now, new ones would flock in before long, and nothing would change. Unless there's strong, constant protection at sea like the old Pandragon navy, I don't think things can get better.
Kaja - Then what if we opened a new sea route that avoids the waters around Blueseed? If we find a safe route where pirates rarely appear, we could cut our losses even if it takes a little longer.

Baja - The pirates' seamanship wouldn't let them follow us onto a route that isn't on the existing charts, but finding a new route is just as much of a burden for us. Above all, it won't be easy to find a captain willing to take on such dangerous work...
Kaja - Then what if I went to sea myself? If I can find a good navigator and a geographer, you'd agree, wouldn't you, Father?
Baja - No, no, no. A place as rough as the sea is no place for you. Stop talking nonsense, a seventeen-year-old girl, and let's think of some other way.
